name: Transcom (Partner)
desc:
Tech Support & CSR Roles| $17.31 | MUST TAKE ASSESSMENT FROM HOME (IP addresses are looked at and when multiple IP addresses match, they are all declined) NOT co-working friendly.

 https://careers.transcom.com/job-openings/?countries=United+States&locations=Work+at+home
Location: United States, Work at home
Job category: Technical Support Agent
Language: English
Transcom is hiring remote Technical and Customer Experience Advisors to provide customer service and technical support for telecommunications products and services, including smartphones, tablets, and computers. Associates assist customers with troubleshooting technical issues, account questions, billing concerns, and service changes in a fast-paced inbound call center environment.
 

Who It’s a Good Fit For
 Candidates comfortable helping customers over the phone 
 People with strong computer and troubleshooting skills 
 Individuals who can multitask while navigating multiple systems 
 Candidates comfortable in high-volume call center environments 
 People who stay calm with frustrated customers 
 Self-motivated individuals who work well independently from home 
 Candidates interested in technical support and customer experience roles 
Who Shouldn’t Apply
 People uncomfortable handling back-to-back phone calls 
 Candidates who struggle with multitasking or technology 
 Individuals needing flexible childcare during work hours 
 Anyone who dislikes strict schedules or performance expectations 
 Candidates uncomfortable handling upset customers or conflict resolution 
 People without reliable hardwired internet or a private workspace 
 Individuals who prefer slower-paced or low-structure work environments

This is likely a technical implementation role rather than a traditional data entry position. Candidates should have experience working with databases, spreadsheets, software systems, or data migrations. Strong Excel skills, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate with clients are likely critical for success. Participants with IT, business analyst, software support, database, implementation, or advanced reporting backgrounds would be the strongest fit.
notes:
Tell me about a time when you had to deal with a particularly frustrating or angry customer.
Tell me about a time you received negative feedback from a customer. What did you do with the feedback?
Tell me about a time when you were helping a customer that has asked for help from multiple people before you. How did you ensure that the customer got the help they needed from you?
Tell me about a situation where you needed to communicate with a customer who was very different from you. I.e. hard to understand, different primary language, unfamiliar slang or terminology.
Tell me about your least favorite job that you've had and what made you not enjoy it.
Tell me about a work environment where you would not be happy and why.
Your customer is upset and has been on edge for the entire call. At one point, they tell you that you are taking too long to handle their issue. How would you handle an impatient customer?
